PROJECT MANNEQUIN STYLE LOCK. The first image is STRUCTURE/POSE-TIMING ONLY; completely reject its rusty realistic armor, brown palette, spikes, medieval helmet, red visor, texture, and materials. The approved Raider idle, walk, and single-character references define the exact identity: warm-ivory porcelain armor, dark indigo/plum understructure, smooth black visor with one cyan light, cyan-violet chest core, paired tapered back fins, forearm blade shapes, athletic proportions, clean controlled dark contours, broad two-to-four-step anime cel shading, designed highlights, and modern 2.5D fighting-game finish. Mannequin, Ryu, and Goku are authoritative finish anchors. Preserve one exact right-facing three-quarter identity, scale, camera, line weight, light direction, and palette across every frame. Flat pure chroma green #00FF00. Implied cells only; no divider lines, borders, labels, numbers, guides, floor, shadows, scenery, gradients, glow spill, text, or UI. Every full figure complete, independently contained, same baseline where grounded, at least 8 percent safe margin, no overlap or boundary crossing. Reject PBR/rust/grit, identity drift, anatomy errors, duplicated/missing limbs, motion blur, cropped parts, effects, projectiles, or logos.
Create EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows, FOUR row-major jump-state frames mapped to gameplay: 1 grounded jump-start crouch/compression, 2 rising airborne extension, 3 compact apex/fall pose, 4 grounded landing recovery/ready stance. Keep one consistent body scale; airborne frames have clear empty green below both feet, while frames 1 and 4 share one ground baseline. No attack and no flight effects.
